shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular stone slab/pillar face
figures shown in strict profile facing left
wing with rendered feathers (bird wings in A, human-figure's wings in B)
vegetal or frond-like motif with repeated leaf strokes
an arm/limb extended forward holding or reaching toward an object
a border or band framing part of the field
justification: Both are shallow relief on a squared stone face with left-facing profile figures, feathered wings and a stalky plant motif, which gives a loose family resemblance. But A is a multi-register, schematic outline composition of small animals crowded above a zigzag band, whereas B is a single monumental, anatomically modelled figure with dense, controlled incised detail filling the whole field — different scale, competence and compositional logic.
